statements.status_notes: @angular/common 18.2.14 is used by the apicurio-registry-ui web application. No upstream fix is available for the Angular 18.x branch; remediation would require a major Angular version upgrade (20.x or later), which is a breaking change that must be driven by the apicurio-registry upstream. Investigation is ongoing to assess exploitability and monitor for upstream action.
